info.title: BDO App Agent API
info.description: Read-only endpoints exposing SBA loan project data to the Foundry 'SBA Deal Copilot' agent. All endpoints require the x-agent-api-key header. Typical flow: call searchProjects to resolve a business or project name to a projectId, then call the per-project endpoints.

servers.description: BDO App (set to the slot this agent should read from)

get.summary: Search loan projects by business or project name
get.description: Find projects matching a name fragment (case-insensitive) or exact project id. Use this first to resolve which projectId the user is talking about. Returns up to 25 projects, most recently updated first. Omit 'search' to list recent projects.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Business name, project name fragment, or exact project id

get.summary: Get a one-call overview of a loan project
get.description: Core project record plus normalized loan-application fields (legal name, industry, NAICS, loan amount, use of proceeds, owners, etc.) and counts/flags for what other data exists (diligence report, financial spreads, credit pulls, uploads). Call this before deciding which detail endpoints to use.

get.summary: Get the full saved loan application
get.description: The complete structured loan application (business applicant, project overview, individual applicants/owners, program-specific sources & uses, funding structure). SSNs and dates of birth are redacted. Large response — prefer getProjectSummary unless field-level detail is needed.

Financial spreads parsed from uploaded Excel workbooks (business cash flow, guarantor draws, post-close liquidity, personal financial statement values), newest first. Use these numbers for DSCR and liquidity calculations instead of estimating.

200.description: Array of parsed spreads (empty if none uploaded)

get.description: Credit-pull history for the project's individual applicants: bureau, score and score model, hit/no-hit, OFAC status, and a parsed tradeline summary. No raw bureau data or identity details are included.

200.description: Array of credit pulls (empty if none)

get.description: The latest AI-generated due-diligence report for the project as markdown (entity verification, industry/market analysis, online reputation, risk factors, open questions, sources), with generation metadata.

Documents the borrower or broker has uploaded for this project: file name, upload date, detected form type, and OCR extraction status. Useful for answering what has been received and what is still missing.

200.description: Array of upload records (empty if none)
